plan.goal: Plan a fictitious inventory reconciliation from fixed sample products. Scheduler simulation receipts illustrate the workflow; they do not produce a stock report.

tasks.title: Specify sample products
tasks.description: Define a deterministic list of sample product IDs, quantities, and prices.
acceptance_criteria: Sample fields and record count are specified.
escalation_conditions: Human review if acceptance is unverified or retry budget is exhausted

simulation.output: Synthetic sample-product receipt; no inventory file generated.

tasks.title: Define normalization rules
tasks.description: State how product IDs and units would be normalized.
acceptance_criteria: Normalization rules cover identifiers and units.
escalation_conditions: Human review if acceptance is unverified or retry budget is exhausted

simulation.output: Synthetic normalization-rule receipt; no data transformed.

tasks.title: Define product categories
tasks.description: Map each sample product to a simple category for reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Every sample product has one category rule.
escalation_conditions: Human review if acceptance is unverified or retry budget is exhausted

simulation.output: Synthetic category-rule receipt; no mapping executed.

tasks.title: Specify stock valuation
tasks.description: Define quantity-times-price totals and currency rounding.
acceptance_criteria: Formula and rounding convention are specified.
escalation_conditions: Human review if acceptance is unverified or retry budget is exhausted

simulation.output: Synthetic valuation receipt; no totals calculated.

tasks.title: Design reconciliation checks
tasks.description: Define checks for unmatched products, quantities, and category totals.
acceptance_criteria: Mismatch categories and expected checks are listed.
escalation_conditions: Human review if acceptance is unverified or retry budget is exhausted

simulation.output: Synthetic reconciliation receipt; no checks executed.

tasks.title: Review inventory summary plan
tasks.description: Outline the final inventory table and discrepancy summary.
acceptance_criteria: Outline references valuation and reconciliation results.
escalation_conditions: Human review if acceptance is unverified or retry budget is exhausted

simulation.output: Synthetic summary-outline receipt; no report produced.
